A '''planet''' was [[Unidentified Mandalorian battle|attacked]] by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. [[Canderous Ordo]] recalled the battle to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] describing it as a "placid" [[Planet/Legends|world]].
